citation.authors: Laukkanen T, Khan H, Zaccardi F, Laukkanen JA

cited_by.title: Sauna and heat bathing: heart health, recovery and risks

record.population: Middle-aged men (42 to 60) in eastern Finland, Kuopio Ischaemic Heart Disease cohort
record.design: Prospective cohort, median follow-up 20.7 years; sauna frequency and duration at baseline
record.finding: Compared with one session a week, men using a sauna 4 to 7 times a week had about two-thirds lower risk of sudden cardiac death (hazard ratio 0.37, 95% CI 0.18 to 0.75), and lower fatal heart and all-cause mortality. Sessions over 19 minutes were linked to lower risk than sessions under 11 minutes.
record.note: Observational, Finnish men, dry sauna habits. It cannot show that sauna caused the lower risk.
